summary: Adds a way to advertise, using OSPF and IS-IS, whether a Path Computation Element supports PCEP security mechanisms such as TLS. Without this, clients discovering PCEs through the IGP could not tell whether a secure session was possible.

eli5.summary: A shop posts a sign saying whether it has a safe, locked entrance, so customers know before they walk over.

questions: how to advertise pcep tls support
pced extensions for ospf and is-is
